snippet.title: Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix + PV Trailer
snippet.description:
Lol, besides the credited person, I was the only one to upload this to YouTube. Him and I are the only ones with downloadable versions of the video. I'm the one who provided a download link to this trailer on KHInsider.com, so those of you who came here and uploaded the video that you downloaded from there: You're Welcome, guys. Hahahaha XD

Anywho, since I'm the second person to upload this on YouTube. Bragging rights. lol j/k. =)

Anyways, Just as the title says.
Complete credit goes to Tomo and futuunohito.

Enjoy!
